criteria.description: Apply the original criterion to the exact words and scope. Votes never grant acceptance or override authority.
State missing history, supplied-member-return and mode limitations. Do not authenticate forgeable records.

Preserve all nine protections: unanimous-skip, protected-work, evidence-before-action, advance-ordering, fresh-review, review-depth, valid-test-skip, A49-provenance, per-item-human-authority. No unanimity/GREEN/label authenticates authority; protected Discovery/Review, depth, ordering and A49 remain.

Name evidence limits and refer suspicious/missing/copied sources; preserve exact existing human words/action/base/conditions, validation/round trip/Closes only where actually evidenced. Denied/disabled tools provide no posting proof.
